itemListElement.name: How to Get Your Crypto Project Into Forbes in 2026

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Forbes editorial and Forbes Councils?

acceptedAnswer.text: Forbes editorial is staff-written or editorially commissioned journalism that carries the full credibility of the Forbes masthead. Forbes Councils is a paid membership programme that gives members the ability to publish articles on Forbes.com under a clearly marked Forbes Councils byline and disclaimer. They appear on the same domain but carry very different weight with journalists, investors and AI engines. Sophisticated readers know the difference immediately.

mainEntity.name: How do I pitch my crypto project to Forbes reporters?

acceptedAnswer.text: Identify the specific Forbes reporter who covers the beat your story belongs to, whether that is technology, finance, or business, and pitch a story they would want to file: a business or technology angle with a hard news hook and on-the-record data, not a product announcement. Offer a brief, embargoed window and availability for a direct interview. Follow up once after five business days if there is no reply. The full pitch structure and timing logic applies to Forbes the same way it applies to any tier-1 outlet.

mainEntity.name: Is Forbes Councils worth it for a crypto startup?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the goal. If you want to build a byline record on a high-authority domain and develop an editorial writing habit, Councils can serve that purpose at a reasonable cost. If you want the credibility signal that a Forbes editorial placement provides with investors, journalists and enterprise buyers, Councils does not deliver that, and the budget is better directed toward earning real media coverage.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to earn a real Forbes feature?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most Forbes editorial placements take between three and nine months of narrative build before the Forbes pitch lands. That includes establishing the founder's byline record on crypto and business outlets, getting the founder quoted in tier-2 Forbes pieces as a source, developing a data or research angle, and timing the full pitch to a hard news event. Forbes features rarely happen cold, without prior coverage history or a named relationship with the reporter.

mainEntity.name: Does a Forbes feature help with AI search results for my project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, meaningfully. Forbes is one of the high-authority sources that AI engines including ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI Mode draw on when assembling answers about business and technology topics. A staff-written Forbes editorial about your project is the kind of authoritative, attributed source those engines surface in AI Overviews and generative answers. A Forbes Councils article with a membership disclaimer is treated differently by both readers and engines. The authority signal is in the editorial, not the domain alone.
